description: Active public Meta ads worldwide (plus EU/UK/BR and political archives) from one static binary — zero browser, zero API key required, plus local SQLite competitive intelligence.

tools.name: ads_details
tools.description: Fetch full ad details and EU/UK/BR transparency disclosures for a single ad. Optional: ad_id, page_id.

params.name: ad_id
params.description: Numeric Meta Ad Library archive ID

params.name: page_id
params.description: Numeric Facebook Page ID

tools.name: ads_search
tools.description: Search public Meta ads globally by keyword, page ID, brand name, or Ad Library URL. Optional: query, country (default: US), limit (default: 20).

params.name: query
params.description: Keyword search string

params.name: country
params.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum ads to return

tools.name: advertisers_search
tools.description: Resolve a brand or advertiser name to its Facebook Page ID, likes, IG handle, and verification. Optional: query, country (default: US).

params.name: query
params.description: Brand or Facebook Page name

params.name: country
params.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code

tools.name: archive_list
tools.description: Query official Meta Ad Library Graph API v27.0 ads_archive for political/issue ads globally and all EU/UK/BR ads. Required: ad_reached_countries. Optional: search_terms, search_page_ids, ad_type (default: ALL) (plus 15 more). Returns array of ArchivedAd. (requires API key)

params.name: ad_reached_countries
params.description: JSON array of ISO country codes or ALL (e.g. '['US']', '['DE','FR']', '['ALL']'). Non-EU commercial ads only return if POLITICAL_AND_ISSUE_ADS.

params.name: search_terms
params.description: Keywords to search in ad text, image text, video audio, and CTA (max 100 chars; space is logical AND)

params.name: search_page_ids
params.description: JSON array or comma-separated list of up to 10 Facebook Page IDs (e.g. '['15087023444']')

params.name: ad_type
params.description: Ad category filter (ALL, POLITICAL_AND_ISSUE_ADS, HOUSING_ADS, EMPLOYMENT_ADS, FINANCIAL_PRODUCTS_AND_SERVICES_ADS)

params.name: ad_active_status
params.description: Delivery eligibility status filter (ACTIVE, INACTIVE, ALL)

params.name: search_type
params.description: Keyword matching mode (KEYWORD_UNORDERED or KEYWORD_EXACT_PHRASE)

params.name: media_type
params.description: Creative media type filter (ALL, IMAGE, MEME, VIDEO, NONE)

params.name: publisher_platforms
params.description: JSON array or comma-separated Meta platforms (FACEBOOK, INSTAGRAM, AUDIENCE_NETWORK, MESSENGER, WHATSAPP, OCULUS, THREADS, STREAMING_SERVICES)

params.name: languages
params.description: JSON array of ISO 639-1 language codes (e.g. '['en','es']')

params.name: ad_delivery_date_min
params.description: Return ads delivered on or after this UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: ad_delivery_date_max
params.description: Return ads delivered on or before this UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: bylines
params.description: JSON array of exact 'paid for by' disclaimer bylines (POLITICAL_AND_ISSUE_ADS only)

params.name: delivery_by_region
params.description: JSON array of sub-country regions such as states or provinces (POLITICAL_AND_ISSUE_ADS only)

params.name: estimated_audience_size_min
params.description: Minimum estimated audience boundary (100, 1000, 5000, 10000, 50000, 100000, 500000, 1000000; POLITICAL_AND_ISSUE_ADS only)

params.name: estimated_audience_size_max
params.description: Maximum estimated audience boundary (1000, 5000, 10000, 50000, 100000, 500000, 1000000; POLITICAL_AND_ISSUE_ADS only)

params.name: unmask_removed_content
params.description: Reveal ad content removed for violating Meta standards

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated ArchivedAd fields to request from Graph API

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum archived ads per page (1-100)

params.name: after
params.description: Graph API pagination cursor from previous response paging.cursors.after
